001: Good morning, Lucas! You're already here? What a surprise!
Good morning, Fernanda! I came in earlier because I needed to finish a report.
Wow, so dedicated! Was the report for that new client?
That's right. It was finished last night, but I preferred to review everything again.
That makes sense. Better safe than sorry, right?
Definitely. Now I'm going to get a coffee to fully wake up.
002: Gabriel, did you have lunch at the new restaurant that opened nearby?
Not yet, Ana. I heard the food is great, but the prices are steep.
That's true, but they say the self-service is worth it for the variety.
Then maybe I'll try it on Friday. Do you want to go with me?
I'd love to! We'll set it up at lunchtime, then.
Perfect. It'll be nice to chat outside the office for a while.
003: Rafael, did you see the email the board sent a little while ago?
I did, Camila. They changed the project deadline again, didn't they?
They did. Now the final delivery is scheduled for next week.
That's going to tighten our schedule. Are we going to need extra help?
I think so. I'm going to talk to management to ask for another intern.
Good idea. If you need it, I can review the documents that are already done.
004: Beatriz, did you notice that Felipe is acting a bit strange today?
I did. He barely answered when I said good morning.
Do you think he's worried about tomorrow's presentation?
Maybe. He always gets nervous when he has to speak in public.
Maybe we should offer to help him rehearse.
I agree. I'll invite him to lunch and see how he's feeling.
005: Felipe, what did you think of yesterday's meeting about the new goals?
Honestly, Fernanda, I found the goals quite challenging.
Me too. But I think with planning we can achieve them.
You're right. The problem is that time seems short for so much.
If we organize the tasks by priority, it gets easier.
Good suggestion. We can put together a schedule together this week.
006: Ana, can you tell me where the meeting room on the third floor is?
Sure, Lucas. It's the second door on the left, near the break room.
Thanks! I'm going to present the project to the marketing team there.
How nice! Do you want me to bring the projector for you?
If it's not too much trouble, I'd really appreciate it.
No problem at all. I'll walk you there.
007: Gabriel, have you finished the sales spreadsheet for last quarter?
Almost, Camila. I just need to include the data from the South region.
I need it by the end of the day to close the monthly report.
No worries. I'll finish it by early afternoon and send it to you.
Perfect. If you need any information, just call me.
Thanks, Camila. You're a very thoughtful colleague.
008: Rafael, are you going to the company get-together on Saturday?
I haven't decided yet, Beatriz. I'm a bit tired from this week.
Oh, come on, go! It'll be a great opportunity for us to relax.
That's true. And will everyone from our team be there?
They will. Fernanda even promised to bring that chocolate cake of hers.
Decided then. With that dessert, I can't stay out of it.
009: Camila, can you help me with a question about the new system?
Sure, Felipe. What do you need to know?
I can't attach the files to the expense form.
Oh, that happens when the file is too large. Try compressing it.
Let me see... It worked! Thanks so much for the help.
You're welcome! If you have any other questions, feel free to come find me.
010: Ana, did you notice that the lunch time is going to change starting next month?
I did, Gabriel. It's going to be from one to two o'clock, right?
That's right. I thought it would be better for everyone.
Me too. That way we avoid that peak hour at the restaurant.
Exactly. And there's still more time to rest after eating.
Good change. I hope the company keeps this arrangement for a long time.
